title: Hearty Norwegian Cilantro Confit
description: A citrusy, snappy Norwegian dish featuring cilantro leaves and confit-tomato, perfect for a sick day. This paleo-friendly recipe is cooked to perfection in a cataplana vessel.
instructions: Brown the chicken thighs in a hot cataplana vessel over medium-high heat.
Add the confit tomatoes, 1/4 cup of water, and salt to taste. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add a handful of fresh cilantro leaves to the cataplana and simmer for an additional 5 minutes.
Season with lemon juice and serve hot over rice or with a side of steamed vegetables.
Garnish with additional cilantro leaves, if desired.
